findings.claim: No test covers the line in showMenu() that re-selects the last raced track, `startScreen.select(menuTrack.id)`. The only test of selection after QUIT TO MENU (AC4) picks Hay Loop by clicking its card and races Hay Loop. The card is already selected, so the line changes nothing in that test, and deleting it passes every test.
findings.evidence: Mutation: delete `startScreen.select(menuTrack.id);` at src/game.ts:303. tests/game/track-select-race.test.ts AC4 clicks the Hay Loop card, presses RACE, then quits. The start screen keeps `selected === 'hay-loop'` in its own closure, so `card(root, hay)?.getAttribute('aria-checked')` is still 'true' and the test passes. The line only matters when the raced track differs from the selected card. Example: select Hay Loop, press RACE, finish, press NEXT RACE (onNextRace runs enterRace(nextTrackId('hay-loop'))), then pause and QUIT TO MENU. With the line, the menu selects the track just raced. Without it, Hay Loop stays selected. No test plays NEXT RACE then quits, or calls game.startRace({trackId}) and then game.showMenu() while checking which card is aria-checked.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a test in a new file under tests/game/. Call game.startRace({ trackId: 'hay-loop' }) directly while the first card is selected, or play to results and press NEXT RACE. Then call game.showMenu(), or press QUIT TO MENU, and assert that the card of game.state().trackId is the only one with aria-checked="true".

checked.how: Card count, names and order come from TRACKS, not hard-coded values. The path `d` must match /^M[\d.\s-]+L/, so an empty or NaN outline fails. Taking the cards out of the radiogroup or renaming the label fails too.

Checks 40370 → 'BEST 0:40.37', 'fast' → dashes and an unset value → dashes. In the throwing case, Storage.prototype.getItem is spied. happy-dom's getItem is a prototype method (node_modules/happy-dom/lib/storage/Storage.js:111), so the spy takes effect. Removing the try/catch in best-laps read would crash createGame and fail the test.

The test checks the first track is selected at start, a click moves the selection with exactly one checked card, and ArrowLeft wraps first→last and ArrowRight wraps last→first. Off-by-one changes or dropping the modulo wrap in the start-screen.ts keydown handler would fail.

Replacing onRace's `startScreen.selected()` with menuTrack.id (TRACKS[0]) fails the trackId 'hay-loop' check. The test also checks 6 racers and cars and that activeElement is the RACE button. Removing refreshBests() from show() fails AC5 (it reads 39990 after quit). Removing the select() line in showMenu survives (F1).

Checks the h1 text, three .ui-stripe elements in red, mustard, cream order, an svg[role=img] with aria-label containing '#1' and more than 3 drawn shapes, and that the radiogroup is outside the panel.

expectSweep checks the overlay is still present at 329 ms and gone at 330 ms, so a changed SCREEN_CHANGE_MS fails. Removing the overlay from onQuit, onRaceAgain, onNextRace or enterRace fails, and so does adding one to game.startRace or driver.startRace. matchMedia is stubbed explicitly, and the reduced-motion test fails if reducedMotion() ignores the media query.
Every flow asserts state afterwards (mode 'menu' or 'race', the trackId, or the BEST text changed only after show), so a missing button cannot pass silently.
